summary: Quantized token rounding led to micro-credit omission on finalized invoice
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports a small expected billing credit (~$0.40) missing from a finalized invoice for billing window 2026-02-27 to 2026-03-01. The credit was expected because of cumulative rounding deltas from quantized model variants used in their reserved capacity jobs. Impact: finance reconciliation for NimbleDocs failed and autopay flagged the invoice as having an unexpected negative/zeroed line, blocking automatic payment.

Impact: NimbleDocs cannot auto-reconcile month-end billing; they are asking for a clear explanation, immediate provisional credit, and steps to prevent recurrence.

Environment: Dedicated cluster (org token): org-nimble-001, region: us-east-1, serving runtime on quantized model variants (gptq-13b-q4), billing reconciler v2.1.

Relevant invoice excerpt provided by customer (anonymized): invoice_2026-03-01 line items: 
- reserved_hours: 720h @ reserved-rate
- warm_cache_writes: 3 @ $0.00
- quantized_metering_adjustment: -$0.00 (expected -$0.43)

Customer expectation: a final credit of -$0.43 from rounding deltas that had appeared as provisional credits during the cycle but were not applied at finalization.

Customer asks: (1) why the provisional microcredit disappeared on finalization; (2) confirm if they will be refunded or credited; (3) how to avoid these micro-deltas in future.
steps_to_reproduce: Run a mixed reserved job using gptq-13b-q4 with many short-lived microbatches (typical sequence lengths 32-96)
Enable quantization profile Q4 and run at small microbatch size to force fractional token-attribution across microbatches
Observe provisional credits in daily provisional reconciliation UI (Console -> Billing -> Provisional Adjustments)
Finalize invoice via the nightly invoicing pipeline and compare provisional adjustments to finalized invoice lines
logs: Customer-provided postback IDs: pb_20260228_98123, pb_20260228_98124. Sample reconciler trace (anonymized): reconciler/v2.1 applied rounding_floor per microbatch, delta_accumulator=0.4327 USD, threshold_for_auto_credit=1.00 USD, credit_skipped=true. Billing pipeline run id: bill-run-2026-03-01-07z. See attached customer CSV in ticket (not included here).
comments: 2026-03-10 Aisha K: Opened with NimbleDocs. Attached invoice PNG and provisional adjustments exported from console.
2026-03-10 Support (Daniel R): Acknowledged, setting P1. Collecting reconciler logs and escalation to billing-engineering.
2026-03-11 Billing Eng (Maya T): Reproducer created in staging. Found that reconciler uses per-microbatch floor rounding which can accumulate fractional deltas below auto-credit threshold.
2026-03-12 Daniel R: Provisional credit issued while we investigate. Sent customer note: issued temporary credit of $0.43 as invoice adjustment pending root-cause fix.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis: quantized variants change token-cost normalization leading to fractional-dollar deltas accumulated across thousands of microbatches. Our reconciler previously applied an auto-credit only when cumulative delta >= $1.00 (legacy threshold). Queries run: (1) aggregate token-delta by postback id: delta totals matched customer-provided 0.4327 USD; (2) inspected reconciler config flag billing.reconciler.auto_credit_threshold == 1.00; (3) confirmed provisional credits shown during cycle but finalizer suppressed microcredits when under threshold. Additional finding: a nearby code change in PR #8123 replaced rounding to nearest cent with floor-per-microbatch for performance reasons, increasing drop of fractional values. Staging reproducer: created synthetic load that produced 0.39-0.55 USD deltas which were not auto-credited on finalization. Impact surface: primarily dedicated customers running many short microbatches on quantized variants. Metrics: ~12 customers in last 30 days with cumulative < $1 delta but visible provisional credits.
resolution: Temporary fix: issued provisional invoice adjustment / credit of $0.43 to NimbleDocs (manual adjustment id: adj-2026-03-12-DS). Customer notified and autopay cleared. Permanent fix: billing-engineering merged PR #8137 to (1) change reconciler rounding to banker's rounding at the accumulator level and (2) lower auto_credit_threshold from $1.00 to $0.10 for quantized-variant deltas. PRs: github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/8137, github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/8123 (revert partial floor behavior). Deploy plan: roll out reconciler v2.1.1 to prod during low-traffic window on 2026-03-15 with canary in us-east. Follow-ups: add unit test for accumulator rounding, add dashboard alert when customers have >10 micro-delta reconciliations in a cycle, and update billing docs to explain quantized rounding implications. Assigned follow-up task INT-334210 to Billing Ops for dashboard and runbook updates.
